#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(NULL);

    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;

    int l = 0, r = 0;
    int ans = 0;
    int n = s.length();

    while (l < n) {
        while (r < n && s[r] == s[l]) {
            ++r;
        }
        if (((r - l) & 1) == 0) {
            ++ans;
        }
        l = r;
    }

    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
